Attached: 1 image

Do you use the stylesheet Wakamai Fondue generates for your font?

I have a feeling the CSS might look too complex and scary, especially when the font has many features or axes.

There's weird looking custom properties, quite verbose classnames... and that's with the options set to produce relatively simple, modern CSS.

I wonder, what should be improved to make it more useful, less scary, or both?

🫕 https://wakamaifondue.com/
